According to this arrow-pushing step, only update near boron: form a coordination bond from the carbonyl oxygen to boron, making boron tetracoordinate and negatively charged; the coordinated carbonyl oxygen is written as [O+], while retaining the O=C(Ph)Me fragment; the remaining visible skeleton and stereochemistry are unchanged.
